messages:
toni: quick bring-up for Orpheus-12b (int8 baseline vs int6 + layer-mix experiments). ran 22k mixed-slice eval: longform QA, multi-paragraph summarization, rerank. posting compact take + reliability routing idea.

toni: headline: int6 tuned saves ~18% token cost and improves median latency for short generators, but layer-mix (only quantize middle transformer blocks) recovers ~60% of the QA drop while keeping ~12% cost savings. interesting tradeoff.

ara: numbers + sample split?

toni: samples=22k (9k long-QA, 8k summarization, 5k rerank). hosted proxy unit: int8=$0.0098/k tok, int6=$0.0080/k tok (~18% save). layer-mix (LMix) = $0.0086/k tok (~12% save). p50 lat: int8 485ms, int6 420ms, LMix 440ms. p95: int8 1085ms, int6 1120ms, LMix 1100ms.

vik: quality metrics and where LMix helps?

toni: main metric = long-QA exact-match (LQA). scores: int8 82.0%, int6 78.1% (-3.9pp), LMix 80.5% (-1.5pp vs int8). reranker MAP: int8 84.6, int6 80.9 (-3.7), LMix 83.2 (-1.4). summarization ROUGE-L stable across variants (~0.69). KV-cache hit for long queries: int8 0.67, int6 0.60, LMix 0.64.

mai: nice, LMix seems promising. how complex to deploy?

toni: LMix requires model variant build (mixed-quant checkpoint) and runtime support to pick kernels per-layer; infra work but feasible. Ops notes: slightly higher memory than int6, same operator path with conditional kernel selection.

ara: routing idea? product implications?

toni: propose reliability tiers: "standard" (cost-aware) -> routes eligible short-gen to int6; "balanced" -> route to LMix for mid-risk flows; "strict" -> always int8. Add SDK hint: {"feature":"summary","est_out":200,"reliability":"balanced"}. Also add shadow-rescore: for any top-K rerank or long-QA pick on int6/LMix, shadow-score top-3 on int8 at 0.5% sampling to estimate real-time quality delta.

vik: monitoring & canary plan? thresholds?

toni: Canary: 72h on selected customers. Start 5% traffic for LMix in balanced tier and 10% for int6 in standard tier. Track: LQA exact-match by slice, reranker MAP, top1-flip-rate, p95 latency, unit-cost. Alerts: LQA drop >1.5pp for LMix or >2.5pp for int6. Shadow-rescore helps detect regressions early.

mai: what about decoding or prompt rewrites to reduce KV length instead?

toni: good idea: product can add a light prompt-rewrite preprocessor that trims context or compresses long passages (summarize docs before QA) to lower KV pressure; that improves int6 quality in many cases and could expand eligible traffic. We'll prototype a client-side preprocessor as an optional hook.

ara: action items: (1) eng-platform: add reliability-tier routing + SDK hint (2) infra: build LMix variant + kernel selection support (3) observability: canary dashboard + shadow-rescore pipeline + failing-query capture (4) product: add prompt-rewrite hook in SDK and opt-in UI.
